employment_notes: Russia's baseline standard SPG throughout the war, functionally the Russian-side counterpart to Ukraine's donated M109/PzH2000 in the tool's artillery comparison
contrast_vs_traditional: The same shoot-and-scoot pressure applies on the Russian side of the line: a tracked Soviet-lineage gun built for sustained fire missions now displaces as fast as its crew can manage once a round is downrange, because the drone spotting a firing position feeds counter-battery fire on the same minutes-scale timeline doctrine.md documents for the kill chain generally, not just for Ukrainian-fired systems.
